prefillDecisions.question: Q-UC1a-1 — Order routing logic (Cash Sale vs. Sales Order)
prefillDecisions.source: flo.json UC1a description + Celigo SIA domain knowledge
prefillDecisions.prefillValue: payment_status = 'paid' AND customer is DTC → Cash Sale; wholesale / net-terms / B2B → Sales Order
prefillDecisions.rationale: This routing logic is the core discriminator for UC1a vs UC1b. Celigo SIA standard pattern; confirmed from flo.json flow descriptions.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-UC1a-3 — NetSuite single subsidiary vs. OneWorld
prefillDecisions.source: vera.json company profile — single storefront, no multi-subsidiary indicators
prefillDecisions.rationale: No OneWorld indicators in briefing. If wrong, every NetSuite write fails. Critical to confirm.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-UC2a-1 — Refund routing: Credit Memo vs. Customer Refund
prefillDecisions.source: Celigo SIA standard pattern + NetSuite refund record types
prefillDecisions.prefillValue: Partial refund → Credit Memo; Full refund → Customer Refund
prefillDecisions.rationale: Standard Celigo SIA refund routing. NetSuite requires different record types for partial vs. full refunds.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-UC4-1 — Inventory sync schedule
prefillDecisions.source: Industry standard for Shopify Plus DTC brands
prefillDecisions.rationale: 15-minute intervals are standard for DTC brands with high order volume. Confirms with Celigo SIA defaults.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-UC4-2 — CSWOS threshold values
prefillDecisions.source: Left blank — business rule unique to Homage
prefillDecisions.rationale: CSWOS thresholds are client-specific business logic. Cannot infer from any available data. Must be provided by Homage.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-UC5a-2 — Shopify metafield namespace/key definitions
prefillDecisions.rationale: Metafield definitions are Shopify-instance-specific. Celigo currently writes to these; Sikich or Homage admin can export from Shopify Admin → Settings → Custom data.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-UC6-1 — NetSuite custom field name for image URL
prefillDecisions.source: NetSuite custom field naming convention (custbody_ prefix)
prefillDecisions.rationale: Low confidence estimate based on common naming conventions. Sikich holds the actual field name.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-UC7a-1 — Customer deduplication strategy
prefillDecisions.source: Celigo SIA standard pattern for customer sync
prefillDecisions.prefillValue: Lookup by email → update if found, create if not
prefillDecisions.rationale: Email deduplication is the Celigo SIA standard. Prevents duplicate customer records across Shopify/NetSuite.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-UC7c-1 — Customer master record system
prefillDecisions.source: Business logic inference: DTC = Shopify master; B2B = NetSuite master
prefillDecisions.prefillValue: Shopify = master for DTC; NetSuite = master for B2B/wholesale
prefillDecisions.rationale: Standard bidirectional sync pattern for hybrid DTC+B2B brands. Must confirm to prevent data overwrites.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-UC8-1 — Payment gateway → NetSuite account mapping
prefillDecisions.source: Gateway names identified from Shopify Plus typical setup; NS account IDs unknown
prefillDecisions.prefillValue: Gateway names estimated (shopify_payments, afterpay, paypal, gift_card); NS account internalIds blank
prefillDecisions.rationale: NetSuite bank account internalIds are instance-specific. Cannot infer without NetSuite access. Client must provide.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-Section2 — Auth methods per system
prefillDecisions.prefillValue: NetSuite: TBA; Shopify: Custom App token; ShipStation: Basic auth; Orderful: API key; Laravel: Unknown
prefillDecisions.rationale: Pre-filled from rex.json with high confidence for known systems. Laravel gateway auth remains unknown.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-Section7-4 — CI/CD tool preference
prefillDecisions.source: vera.json company profile — GitHub-based engineering on AWS/Vapor
prefillDecisions.rationale: Homage already uses GitHub for engineering. GitHub Actions is the natural CI/CD choice.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-Section7-5 — Secrets management
prefillDecisions.rationale: Homage runs on AWS/Vapor. AWS Secrets Manager is the natural fit and avoids introducing a new vendor.

prefillDecisions.question: Q-10-NS-1 — NetSuite OneWorld confirmation
prefillDecisions.rationale: Repeated from UC1a for emphasis — this is asked twice because the stakes are high.
